# GitHub Discussions Guidelines — HireSync

Welcome to the **HireSync** GitHub Discussions space! This is where team collaborators, maintainers, and contributors align on system design, propose architectural improvements, brainstorm new features, and answer technical questions.

---

## 📌 Discussion Categories

We organize discussions into 4 dedicated categories:

| Category                  | Icon | Purpose                                                                                                                        |
| :------------------------ | :--- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Architecture & Design** | 🏗️   | Propose database migrations, API contracts, ATS scoring formulas, SLA queue designs, or system refactoring before writing code |
| **Feature Ideas**         | 💡   | Brainstorm new product capabilities for the **Candidate Portal** or **HR / Company Portal**                                    |
| **General Q&A**           | ❓   | Ask questions about local environment setup, testing scripts, `.env` parameters, or troubleshooting                            |
| **Announcements**         | 📢   | Project updates, milestone releases, and repository news from maintainers                                                      |

---

## 🤝 How Collaborators Should Use Discussions

1. **Discuss Before Implementing Large Changes**: If your task involves modifying database schemas, changing JWT authentication, altering ATS weights, or adding new API endpoints, open an **Architecture Proposal** discussion first.
2. **Tag Relevant Team Members**: Mention your branch collaborators to review design proposals.
3. **Convert Approved Proposals to Tasks**: Once a design discussion reaches alignment, link it to the relevant branch in [`TASKS.md`](../TASKS.md).
